Name: EQUIP_PARAM_WEAPON_ST
Description: Weapons, shields, catalysts, arrows and bolts. The last two digits of an ID are the upgrade level: the game reads the row at the ID rounded down to 100, and the ReinforceParamWeapon row reinforceTypeId + level. Affinities are 100 apart within a weapon's 10000 block: an affinity change moves the ID by (new affinity - old affinity) x 100 when that row exists, otherwise the ID is kept.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds. Appears unused by the game.
Reserved. Appears unused by the game.
Reserved. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: Picks the BehaviorParam rows of the weapon's attacks. Row = P x 100000000 + this x 1000 + J, where J is the last three digits of the animation's behavior judge ID and P is that ID / 1000 (1 when it is below 1000). If that row is missing (judge IDs of 1000 and up), the value rounded down to a multiple of 100 is tried. Values above 99999 are ignored.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Inventory sort order. The game multiplies it by 100 and adds the upgrade level. Negative: not sorted. Retail: 9999999 on unused rows.

Fields.Name: Wandering Equip ID
Fields.Description: When above 0, the character's equipment model is built from this weapon ID instead of this one. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Weight. Added to the equip load with the other equipped weapons and armor.

Fields.Name: Weapon Weight %
Fields.Description: Returned by a weight getter; what uses it was not followed. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Repair Price
Fields.Description: Repair cost. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Price
Fields.Description: Upgrade cost in runes: this x the reinforce row's reinforcePriceRate, rounded down.

Fields.Name: Sell Price
Fields.Description: Runes received when selling the weapon.

Fields.Name: Correction: STR
Fields.Description: Strength scaling. The damage calculation uses this x the ReinforceParamWeapon correctStrengthRate of the upgrade level, with the CalcCorrectGraph of the damage type. An AttackElementCorrectParam override replaces this value.

Fields.Name: Correction: DEX
Fields.Description: Dexterity scaling. The damage calculation uses this x the ReinforceParamWeapon correctAgilityRate of the upgrade level, with the CalcCorrectGraph of the damage type. An AttackElementCorrectParam override replaces this value.

Fields.Name: Correction: INT
Fields.Description: Intelligence scaling. The damage calculation uses this x the ReinforceParamWeapon correctMagicRate of the upgrade level, with the CalcCorrectGraph of the damage type. An AttackElementCorrectParam override replaces this value.

Fields.Name: Correction: FTH
Fields.Description: Faith scaling. The damage calculation uses this x the ReinforceParamWeapon correctFaithRate of the upgrade level, with the CalcCorrectGraph of the damage type. An AttackElementCorrectParam override replaces this value.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Physical
Fields.Description: Physical damage blocked when guarding, in percent. x ReinforceParamWeapon physicsGuardCutRate, plus the Dexterity bonus (Guard Absorption DEX Bonus: Physical), then changed by the slash/strike/thrust modifier of the attack's physical type. Retail: 100 on most shields.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Magic
Fields.Description: Magic damage blocked when guarding, in percent. x ReinforceParamWeapon magicGuardCutRate, plus the Dexterity bonus (Guard Absorption DEX Bonus: Magic).

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Fire
Fields.Description: Fire damage blocked when guarding, in percent. x ReinforceParamWeapon fireGuardCutRate, plus the Dexterity bonus (Guard Absorption DEX Bonus: Fire).

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Lightning
Fields.Description: Lightning damage blocked when guarding, in percent. x ReinforceParamWeapon thunderGuardCutRate, plus the Dexterity bonus (Guard Absorption DEX Bonus: Lightning).

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect 1
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied by the weapon's attacks on hit, after the AtkParam's own five. The reinforce row's Behavior SpEffect [1] Offset is added for the upgrade level (also when this is -1). Skipped when the AtkParam's disableHitSpEffect is on. -1: none. Retail: status buildup effects, for example 105000 on Blood affinities.

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect 2
Fields.Description: Second on-hit SpEffect, as Behavior SpEffect 1. The reinforce row's Behavior SpEffect [2] Offset is added for the upgrade level. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect 3
Fields.Description: Third on-hit SpEffect, as Behavior SpEffect 1. The reinforce row's Behavior SpEffect [3] Offset is added for the upgrade level. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect 1
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while the weapon is equipped. The reinforce row's Passive SpEffect [1] Offset is added for the upgrade level. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect 2
Fields.Description: Second passive SpEffect, as Passive SpEffect 1. The reinforce row's Passive SpEffect [2] Offset is added. -1: none. Retail: 1940 on the Shortbow.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect 3
Fields.Description: Third passive SpEffect, as Passive SpEffect 1. The reinforce row's Passive SpEffect [3] Offset is added. -1: none. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Material Set ID
Fields.Description: Upgrade materials: the EquipMtrlSetParam row is this + the reinforce row's Reinforcement Material Set Offset for the level. Retail: 0 (Smithing Stones) or 2200 (Somber Smithing Stones).

Fields.Name: Weakness Damage Multiplier: A
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier against targets with weakness type A. For arrows and bolts it is multiplied with the paired launcher or ammo's rate. Retail: 1; 1.2-1.3 on gravity and star weapons (NpcParam isWeakA is set on Fallingstar Beasts, Alabaster Lords and Astel).

Fields.Name: Weakness Damage Multiplier: B
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier against targets with weakness type B. For arrows and bolts it is multiplied with the paired launcher or ammo's rate. Retail: 1; 1.2-1.3 on Golden Epitaph and similar, 4 on Holy Water Pots (NpcParam isWeakB is set on skeletons, Death Birds and Ghostflame Dragons).

Fields.Name: Weakness Damage Multiplier: C
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier against targets with weakness type C. For arrows and bolts it is multiplied with the paired launcher or ammo's rate. Retail: 1; 1.05-1.2 on dragon weapons (NpcParam isWeakC is set on the Ancient Dragons and Fortissax).

Fields.Name: Weakness Damage Multiplier: D
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier against targets with weakness type D. For arrows and bolts it is multiplied with the paired launcher or ammo's rate. Retail: 1; 1.1-1.5 on dragon weapons (NpcParam isWeakD is set on dragons such as Greyoll, Ekzykes and Bayle).

Fields.Name: Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Sleep
Fields.Description: Extra sleep buildup blocked when guarding, from Dexterity. Bonus = this x CalcCorrectGraph 162 (Dexterity) / 100 x (Dexterity - requirement) / (PlayerCommonParam guardStatusCorrect_MaxStatusVal - requirement), capped at the full value. Only when all stat requirements are met. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Madness
Fields.Description: Extra madness buildup blocked when guarding, from Dexterity, as Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Sleep. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Poise Damage
Fields.Description: Poise damage of the weapon's attacks. x ReinforceParamWeapon saWeaponAtkRate and the AtkParam's atkSuperArmorCorrection / 100.

Fields.Name: Equip Model ID
Fields.Description: Model number. The model file name is built from it (four digits) and the model category.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon.

Fields.Name: Durability
Fields.Description: Starting durability. Retail: 0 (weapons have no durability).

Fields.Name: Max Durability
Fields.Description: Maximum durability. Retail: 0 (weapons have no durability).

Fields.Name: Throw Escape Damage
Fields.Description: Throw-escape power of the weapon's attacks, scaled by the AtkParam's atkThrowEscapeCorrection. Retail: 1.

Fields.Name: Parry Damage Duration Limit
Fields.Description: Limit on how long parry damage lasts, in frames (/ 30 = seconds). 0 or less: no limit from the weapon. Retail: 10.

Fields.Description: Base physical attack. x ReinforceParamWeapon physicsAtkRate for the upgrade level, then scaled by the AtkParam's physical correction and by stat scaling.

Fields.Name: Damage: Magic
Fields.Description: Base magic attack. x ReinforceParamWeapon magicAtkRate for the upgrade level, then scaled by the AtkParam's magic correction and by stat scaling.

Fields.Name: Damage: Lightning

Fields.Name: Damage: Stamina
Fields.Description: Stamina damage of the weapon's attacks. x ReinforceParamWeapon staminaAtkRate. The AtkParam's atkStam is added when its isAddBaseAtk is on.

Fields.Name: Guard Angle
Fields.Description: Guard angle. Returned by a getter; what uses it was not followed. Retail: 60 on every usable weapon.

Fields.Name: Poise Durability
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Guard Stability
Fields.Description: Guard Boost: stamina damage absorbed when blocking. x ReinforceParamWeapon staminaGuardDefRate, plus the Strength bonus (Guard Boost STR Bonus).

Fields.Name: Reinforce Type ID
Fields.Description: ReinforceParamWeapon row. The upgrade level (the last two digits of the weapon ID) is added to it.

Fields.Name: Trophy Grade ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0-8 on nine legendary armaments, -1 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Trophy Sequence ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Critical Attack Multiplier
Fields.Description: Damage of critical (throw) attacks: x (100 + value) / 100. Retail: 30 on daggers, 40 on the Misericorde, 10 on the Black Knife, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Bow Distance %
Fields.Description: Range of arrows and bolts fired with this weapon: bullet range x ((100 + value) / 100 + SpEffect bow distance bonuses). Retail: -40 Shortbow, -15 Soldier's Crossbow, 0 Longbow; -1 on non-bows.

Fields.Name: Equip Model Category
Fields.Description: Model type used in the model file name. The weapon model setup requires 7. Retail: always 7.

Fields.Name: Equip Model Gender
Fields.Description: Which body types have a model, and whether the model differs per body type (as for armor). Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Weapon Category
Fields.Description: Weapon class for game logic: 13 (arrows) and 14 (bolts) are ammunition (ammo count, weakness rates), 11 crossbows and ballistas, 12 shields and torches. Retail: 0 daggers and throwables, 1 straight swords, greatswords and whips, 2 thrusting swords, 3 curved swords and katanas, 4 axes, 5 hammers, 6 spears, 7 halberds, 8 staffs and seals, 9 fist weapons, 10 bows and greatbows (ballistas are 11). The menu type is wepType.

Fields.Name: Weapon Motion Category
Fields.Description: Moveset (animation category) used with the weapon. Also read by the weapon-enchant visuals.

Fields.Name: Guard Motion Category
Fields.Description: Guard animation type, returned by a getter. Retail: 1 on greatshields.

Fields.Name: Attack Material
Fields.Description: Hit material (sound and effect) of the weapon's attacks, used when the AtkParam's atkMaterial is 255.

Fields.Name: Defence SE Material [1]
Fields.Description: Hit sound material for hits guarded with this weapon, first material slot. Used in place of the defender's armor material when that one is 255.

Fields.Name: Correction Type: Physical
Fields.Description: CalcCorrectGraph row for the stat scaling of physical attack. Retail: 0 Standard, 1 Heavy, 2 Keen, 4 elemental, 7 Occult, 8 Quality.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute
Fields.Description: Element of the weapon's attacks when the AtkParam's spAttribute is 255. With spAttributeVariationValue it also picks the element's hit SFX and sound.

Fields.Name: Special Motion Category
Fields.Description: Special motion category (50-999) for skill and attack overrides. Also passed to the behavior script.

Fields.Name: Weapon Motion Position - 1H
Fields.Description: One-handed stance. Picks the PostureControlParam aNNN group and stance animations.

Fields.Name: Weapon Motion Position - 2H
Fields.Description: Two-handed stance. Picks the PostureControlParam aNNN group and stance animations.

Fields.Name: Requirement: STR
Fields.Description: Strength needed to wield the weapon. Two-handing counts Strength x 1.5. Unmet requirements remove the guard stat bonuses and apply PlayerCommonParam's low-stat penalties.

Fields.Name: Requirement: DEX
Fields.Description: Dexterity needed to wield the weapon. Unmet requirements remove the guard stat bonuses and apply PlayerCommonParam's low-stat penalties.

Fields.Name: Requirement: INT
Fields.Description: Intelligence needed to wield the weapon. Unmet requirements remove the guard stat bonuses and apply PlayerCommonParam's low-stat penalties.

Fields.Name: Requirement: FTH
Fields.Description: Faith needed to wield the weapon. Unmet requirements remove the guard stat bonuses and apply PlayerCommonParam's low-stat penalties.

Fields.Name: Repel Strength Bonus Start
Fields.Description: Strength above this adds to the guard and attack repel strength: +1 per point, up to +10. Retail: 99 (no bonus in practice), 0 on arrows.

Fields.Name: Base Parry Attack
Fields.Description: Parry attack value, returned by a getter; what uses it was not followed. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Base Parry Defense
Fields.Description: Parry defense value, returned by a getter; what uses it was not followed. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Base Guard Repel
Fields.Description: Repel strength when guarding: decides whether an attack bounces off the guard. Scaled per attack by the AtkParam's correction (/ 100); Strength above Repel Strength Bonus Start adds up to 10.

Fields.Name: Base Attack Repel
Fields.Description: Repel strength of the weapon's attacks against a guard. x the AtkParam's guardAtkRateCorrection / 100; Strength above Repel Strength Bonus Start adds up to 10.

Fields.Name: Guard Bypass %
Fields.Description: Changes the blocker's guard absorption against this weapon: x (100 + value) / 100, multiplied with the AtkParam's own guardCutCancelRate the same way. Retail: -50 on the Celebrant's weapons, -30 on the Claws of Night, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Guard Level
Fields.Description: Guard level, returned by a getter; what uses it was not followed. Retail: 1-4, rising from light weapons to greatshields (4).

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Modifier: Slash
Fields.Description: Percent change to physical guard absorption against slash attacks: absorption x (100 + value) / 100. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Modifier: Strike
Fields.Description: Percent change to physical guard absorption against strike attacks: absorption x (100 + value) / 100. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Modifier: Thrust
Fields.Description: Percent change to physical guard absorption against thrust attacks: absorption x (100 + value) / 100. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist: Poison
Fields.Description: Poison buildup blocked when guarding, in percent. x ReinforceParamWeapon poisonGuardResistRate, plus the Dexterity bonus (Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Poison).

Fields.Name: Guard Resist: Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Scarlet Rot buildup blocked when guarding, in percent. x ReinforceParamWeapon diseaseGuardResistRate, plus the Dexterity bonus (Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Scarlet Rot).

Fields.Name: Guard Resist: Blood Loss

Fields.Name: Guard Resist: Death Blight

Fields.Name: Correction Type: Poison
Fields.Description: CalcCorrectGraph row for the Arcane scaling of poison buildup.

Fields.Name: Sort Group ID
Fields.Description: Menu sort group: items with the same group sort together.

Fields.Name: Attack Attribute [2]
Fields.Description: Second physical damage type, used when the AtkParam's atkAttribute is 252.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist: Sleep
Fields.Description: Sleep buildup blocked when guarding, in percent. x ReinforceParamWeapon sleepGuardDefRate, plus the Dexterity bonus (Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Sleep).

Fields.Name: Guard Resist: Madness
Fields.Description: Madness buildup blocked when guarding, in percent. x ReinforceParamWeapon madnessGuardDefRate, plus the Dexterity bonus (Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Madness).

Fields.Name: Correction Type: Blood Loss
Fields.Description: CalcCorrectGraph row for the Arcane scaling of blood loss buildup.

Fields.Name: Requirement: ARC
Fields.Description: Arcane needed to wield the weapon. Unmet requirements remove the guard stat bonuses and apply PlayerCommonParam's low-stat penalties.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist: Frostbite
Fields.Description: Frostbite buildup blocked when guarding, in percent. x ReinforceParamWeapon freezeGuardDefRate, plus the Dexterity bonus (Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Frostbite).

Fields.Name: Auto Replenish Type
Fields.Description: Automatic refill mode, returned by a getter. Retail: 2 on arrows and bolts, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Sword Arts Param ID
Fields.Description: Default skill (SwordArtsParam row).

Fields.Name: Correction: ARC
Fields.Description: Arcane scaling. The damage calculation uses this x the ReinforceParamWeapon correctLuckRate of the upgrade level, with the CalcCorrectGraph of the damage type. An AttackElementCorrectParam override replaces this value.

Fields.Name: Ammunition Equip ID
Fields.Description: Weapon ID of the quiver (bows) or magazine (crossbows) model shown on the character. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Derivation Level Type
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Enchantment SFX Size
Fields.Description: Size variant of the weapon-enchant SFX (greases and buffs).

Fields.Name: Weapon Type
Fields.Description: Weapon type: the menu type name, and the type EquipParamGem checks for Ash of War compatibility.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption DEX Bonus: Physical
Fields.Description: Extra physical guard absorption (percent points) from Dexterity. Bonus = this x CalcCorrectGraph 160 (Dexterity) / 100 x (Dexterity - requirement) / (PlayerCommonParam guardStatusCorrect_MaxStatusVal - requirement), capped at the full value. Only when all stat requirements are met. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption DEX Bonus: Magic
Fields.Description: Extra magic guard absorption (percent points) from Dexterity, as the physical bonus but with CalcCorrectGraph 161. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption DEX Bonus: Fire
Fields.Description: Extra fire guard absorption (percent points) from Dexterity, as the physical bonus but with CalcCorrectGraph 161. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption DEX Bonus: Lightning
Fields.Description: Extra lightning guard absorption (percent points) from Dexterity, as the physical bonus but with CalcCorrectGraph 161. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption DEX Bonus: Holy
Fields.Description: Extra holy guard absorption (percent points) from Dexterity, as the physical bonus but with CalcCorrectGraph 161. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Poison
Fields.Description: Extra poison buildup blocked when guarding, from Dexterity, as Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Sleep. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Extra scarlet rot buildup blocked when guarding, from Dexterity, as Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Sleep. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Extra blood loss buildup blocked when guarding, from Dexterity, as Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Sleep. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Death Blight
Fields.Description: Extra death blight buildup blocked when guarding, from Dexterity, as Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Sleep. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Frostbite
Fields.Description: Extra frostbite buildup blocked when guarding, from Dexterity, as Guard Resist DEX Bonus: Sleep. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Guard Boost STR Bonus
Fields.Description: Extra Guard Boost from Strength (x 1.5 when two-handing). Bonus = this x CalcCorrectGraph 163 / 100 x (Strength - requirement) / (PlayerCommonParam guardStatusCorrect_MaxStatusVal - requirement), capped at the full value. Only when all stat requirements are met. Retail: 0, 5-15 on a few rows.

Fields.Name: Resident SFX [1]
Fields.Description: SFX shown on the weapon while it's equipped, slot 1. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SFX [2]
Fields.Description: SFX shown on the weapon while it's equipped, slot 2. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SFX [3]
Fields.Description: SFX shown on the weapon while it's equipped, slot 3. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SFX [4]
Fields.Description: SFX shown on the weapon while it's equipped, slot 4. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SFX - Dummy Poly [1]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly of resident SFX 1. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SFX - Dummy Poly [2]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly of resident SFX 2. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SFX - Dummy Poly [3]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly of resident SFX 3. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Resident SFX - Dummy Poly [4]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly of resident SFX 4. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Stamina Consumption %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the stamina cost of the weapon's actions.

Fields.Name: Vs. Player - Physical Damage %
Fields.Description: Physical damage multiplier when both the attacker and the target are players. Combined with the SpEffect PvP rates. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Vs. Player - Magic Damage %
Fields.Description: Magic damage multiplier when both the attacker and the target are players. Combined with the SpEffect PvP rates. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Vs. Player - Fire Damage %
Fields.Description: Fire damage multiplier when both the attacker and the target are players. Combined with the SpEffect PvP rates. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Vs. Player - Lightning Damage %
Fields.Description: Lightning damage multiplier when both the attacker and the target are players. Combined with the SpEffect PvP rates. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Vs. Player - Holy Damage %
Fields.Description: Holy damage multiplier when both the attacker and the target are players. Combined with the SpEffect PvP rates. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Vs. Player - Poison Damage %
Fields.Description: Poison buildup multiplier when both the attacker and the target are players. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Vs. Player - Blood Loss Damage %
Fields.Description: Blood loss buildup multiplier when both the attacker and the target are players. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Vs. Player - Frostbite Damage %
Fields.Description: Frostbite buildup multiplier when both the attacker and the target are players. Retail: always 1.

Fields.Name: Unique R2 Attack - STR Requirement
Fields.Description: Behavior-script check: true when Strength and the other four stats reach their values. -1: no requirement. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Unique R2 Attack - DEX Requirement
Fields.Description: Behavior-script check: true when Dexterity and the other four stats reach their values. -1: no requirement. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Unique R2 Attack - INT Requirement
Fields.Description: Behavior-script check: true when Intelligence and the other four stats reach their values. -1: no requirement. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Unique R2 Attack - FTH Requirement
Fields.Description: Behavior-script check: true when Faith and the other four stats reach their values. -1: no requirement. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Unique R2 Attack - ARC Requirement
Fields.Description: Behavior-script check: true when Arcane and the other four stats reach their values. -1: no requirement. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Attack Element Correct ID
Fields.Description: AttackElementCorrectParam row: which stats scale each damage type, with optional scaling overrides.

Fields.Name: Sale Value
Fields.Description: Shop price. Retail: 0 (-1 on unused rows).

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Menu Type
Fields.Description: Upgrade menu the weapon is listed in. Retail: 0 none, 1 weapons, 2 staffs, 3 seals.

Fields.Name: Max Ammunition Held
Fields.Description: Arrows and bolts: maximum count carried. Also sets the steps of the quiver model's remaining-ammo display. Retail: 99 arrows, 30 great arrows, 20 ballista bolts.

Fields.Name: Show Resident SFX [1] when Sheathed
Fields.Description: Read by the resident SFX update for slot 1 (the field name means visible while sheathed). Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Show Resident SFX [2] when Sheathed
Fields.Description: Read by the resident SFX update for slot 2 (the field name means visible while sheathed). Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Show Resident SFX [3] when Sheathed
Fields.Description: Read by the resident SFX update for slot 3 (the field name means visible while sheathed). Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Show Resident SFX [4] when Sheathed
Fields.Description: Read by the resident SFX update for slot 4 (the field name means visible while sheathed). Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Apply Weapon VFX Parameters [0]
Fields.Description: Whether weapon-enchant visuals (SpEffectVfx soul param and invisible weapon settings) apply to weapon model 0. Retail: on.

Fields.Name: Apply Weapon VFX Parameters [1]
Fields.Description: Whether weapon-enchant visuals (SpEffectVfx soul param and invisible weapon settings) apply to weapon model 1. Retail: on for 203 rows.

Fields.Name: Apply Weapon VFX Parameters [2]
Fields.Description: Whether weapon-enchant visuals (SpEffectVfx soul param and invisible weapon settings) apply to weapon model 2. Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Apply Weapon VFX Parameters [3]
Fields.Description: Whether weapon-enchant visuals (SpEffectVfx soul param and invisible weapon settings) apply to weapon model 3. Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Weapon SE ID Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's sound IDs.

Fields.Name: Affinity Price
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Level Sync Correction ID
Fields.Description: CalcCorrectGraph row (310-401: the Multiplayer correction rows) that adjusts the weapon's damage while the wielder's level is synced in multiplayer. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Correction Type: Sleep
Fields.Description: CalcCorrectGraph row for the Arcane scaling of sleep buildup.

Fields.Name: Correction Type: Madness
Fields.Description: CalcCorrectGraph row for the Arcane scaling of madness buildup.

Fields.Name: Rarity
Fields.Description: Rarity shown in the menu and the item acquisition log. Retail: 1 common, 2 rare, 3 legendary.

Fields.Name: Ash of War Type
Fields.Description: Ash of War slot. 0: none. 1 or 2: an Ash of War can be applied when EquipParamGem allows the weapon type and affinity and the reinforce row's enableGemRank reaches the gem's rank. Only 2 passes the extra check used by the Ash of War menu.

Fields.Name: Weapon Regain HP Amount
Fields.Description: Rally HP regained per hit: this x the AtkParam's wepRegainHpScale / 100, plus the AtkParam's atkRegainHp.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Message ID [0]
Fields.Description: First effect text line (Weapon Effect FMG) in the weapon's status. -1 ends the list.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Message ID [1]
Fields.Description: Second effect text line, shown when the first is set. -1 ends the list.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Message ID [2]
Fields.Description: Third effect text line, shown when the first two are set. -1 ends the list.
